Notes: First Jew to settle in Sandberg (Piaski) was Michel Moses who arrived 22 November 1783 (town founded 1775)
Less than twenty years after the 1775 founding Sandberg had 113 Jews; year approximated as ~1795 by editor
198 Jews = 45.9% of the town population; synagogue on Borkowska Street had been approved earlier
Jews were 47% of Sandberg's total population (absolute number not given)
27 naturalization certificates and 33 tolerance certificates issued to Jews in Sandberg (documented presence; subset not population)
Gostyn county (not town) had 1010 Jews in 1871 and 509 in 1895; regional aggregate
Only two Jews in Sandberg in 1921 (Gostyn county had 50 of 48930 residents)
Last Jewish family of the Gostyn/Piaski area (Ewald Jacubowski) moved to Germany in 1927; area-level statement
